newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah falls on stop-loss dollar buying.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah falls on stop-loss dollar buying.

text.p: The Indonesian rupah fell against the dollar in afternoon trading on Wednesday after stop-loss limits were broken, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer stop-loss limits at 2,460 and 2,465 levels were broken, causing operators to cover stop-loss dollar positions in the afternoon.
Spot rupiah was at 2,466.0/68.0 at 0745 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,455.
Dealers said swaps were biddish on foreign buying, but upside was limited by ample rupiah supply in the money market.
